name: auroradocs
description: Connect Claude Desktop to independently granted AuroraCloud workspaces over local stdio.
long_description: AuroraDocs MCP runs on this computer and calls the AuroraCloud API. It does not host an MCP HTTP endpoint. Use an `aur_mcp_client_` credential with owner-approved workspace grants. Optional Obsidian import reads one vault you authorize and never modifies the source.

api_url.title: AuroraCloud API URL
api_url.description: AuroraCloud REST API. This is not an MCP URL.

api_token.title: MCP token
api_token.description: The one-time aur_mcp_client_ credential. Stored in the OS keychain.

obsidian_vault_root.title: Obsidian vault (optional)
obsidian_vault_root.description: Absolute path authorizing read-only analysis of one vault. Leave empty to disable Obsidian tools.

state_dir.title: Private state directory (optional)
state_dir.description: Directory for import journals and reviewable plans. Must stay outside the vault. Defaults to ~/.auroradocs-mcp.
